args.message:
Fix FIN-212: implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money

round_money previously used ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring (and
FIN-212) requiring banker's rounding. This caused tests/test_money.py
to fail in the nightly build (e.g. 2.665 rounds to 2.67 instead of 2.66).

Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so half-cent values round to the nearest even
cent, matching the specification.

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (per FIN-212), but `round_money` in `src/money.py` was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: replaced `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`, so half-cent values round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`, `2.675 -> 2.68`), matching the function's documented behavior and FIN-212.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.

@alex — requesting your review. Thanks!
